description: Identifier linking the row to its record in the Covidence systematic review tool.
How the record was found: 'lit review', or 'found as long term dataset ref in Numata 1999'.
Title of the source paper.
Short-form citation of the source paper.
Full citation of the source paper.
Link to the source paper.
Specific sub-location or plot within the site, as named in the paper.
Harmonised site name; matches site names in the combined dataset and site summary table.
World Database on Protected Areas identifier for the site, where available.
Size of the study area or plot reported in the paper.
Latitude of the site.
Longitude of the site.
Broader administrative or geographic region containing the site.
Month the paper's observation period began.
Year the paper's observation period began.
Month the paper's observation period ended.
Year the paper's observation period ended.
Observation method reported in the paper.
Phenophase of the reported event: flower, fruit, or 'flower/fruiting not differentiated'.
Reported onset of the event, as written in the extraction.
Reported end of the event, as written in the extraction.
Percentage of species taking part in the event, where reported.
Percentage of individuals taking part in the event, where reported.
Reproduction as a percentage of basal area, where reported.
Other description of the event magnitude, where reported.
Onset month as a date (first day of the month). Used as the onset in the analysis.
End month as a date (first day of the month).
Month name of the start of the paper's observation period.
Month name of the end of the paper's observation period.
Start of the paper's observation period as a date.
End of the paper's observation period as a date.
TRUE if monitoring or expert data at the same site recorded the same phenophase within three months of this onset, so the onset is already represented in the monitoring data.
TRUE if an earlier literature onset at the same site and phenophase fell within three months of this onset. The earliest report is kept.
TRUE if either absorbed_by_monitoring or duplicate_of_earlier_lit is TRUE. The analysis script removes literature onsets where this is TRUE.
